verdict.rationale: Railway cloud agents give a coding agent a persistent remote machine. Files stay on the agent's disk, the machine keeps running after you disconnect, and sleeping retains files, so the persistent-runtime half of the story is documented first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic checkpointing or snapshotting of agent state while it works. Deployment rollback is a different feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: automatic checkpoint/snapshot of agent state, restore-from-checkpoint capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working

citations.quote: Your files stay on the agent's disk, and the machine stays running when you disconnect.
Sleeping stops its processes and compute billing while retaining files; deleting the agent removes its disk.
Claude Code runs on the remote machine, with its development tools and persistent disk, while you prompt it and review changes in Desktop.
You can run several sessions on one machine, connect through a desktop app, and return to the same files later.
